messages:
tara: opened a tiny docs PR to correct /generate request schema. the example payload had `metadata` as a string but runtime expects a map/object. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512
ben: thanks. I hit this in an integration test yesterday. our JS SDK marshals metadata as `{}` by default; can we show both `metadata: {}` and a small example with keys?
tara: good idea. adding both. also found curl example used `--data-binary` which caused some users to include raw newlines; switching to `-d` for JSON is clearer.
ci-bot: CI: docs build triggered for PR #512 1
ben: small nit: response example for `/generate` shows `choices: [{text: ...}]` but new schema uses `content: [{type: "output", text: ...}]`. we should show the new nested `content` array. otherwise SDK consumers get confused.
tara: updated response example to `content` array. left a short note: "old `choices[*].text` map to `content[*].text` in migrations" with before/after snippets.
irah: can you also add a one-liner in the param table clarifying that `max_tokens` supersedes `max_new_tokens`? lots of customers still use the old name.
tara: added migration row to the params table and small JS/py examples showing both fields for 90 days.
ben: FYI—I tried to run the examples locally; the Python snippet didn't import `requests` in the sample header. can you add `import requests`?
 tara: fixed python snippet, standardized code fences to `python`, `bash`, `javascript`. removed stray trailing commas in JSON samples.
ci-bot: build passed for PR #512 7
mike: quick question: the OpenAPI example still lists `files` as `object` in schema but examples use array. which do we want?
tara: runtime uses array. fixed schema and regenerated OpenAPI yaml. added a short line in the changelog: "/generate: metadata now object, files are array, response content array replaces choices".
ben: looks good to me. merging once squash done. :shipit:
